(import scheme (chicken base) (chicken io))

(define (tokenize text)
  (define (helper i)
    (if (< i (string-length text))
        (let ((ch (string-ref text i)))
          (cond
           ((char=? ch #\space) (helper (+ i 1)))
           ((char-numeric? ch)
            (let loop ((j i))
              (if (and (< j (string-length text))
                       (char-numeric? (string-ref text j)))
                  (loop (+ j 1))
                  (cons (substring text i j) (helper j)))))
           (else (cons (string ch) (helper (+ i 1))))))))
        '()))
  (reverse (helper 0)))

(define-record-type parser
  (make-parser tokens pos)
  parser?
  (tokens parser-tokens)
  (pos parser-pos))

(define (parser-peek parser)
  (if (< (parser-pos parser) (length (parser-tokens parser)))
      (list-ref (parser-tokens parser) (parser-pos parser))
      #f))

(define (parser-next parser)
  (let* ((tokens (parser-tokens parser))
         (pos (parser-pos parser))
         (token (list-ref tokens pos)))
    (make-parser tokens (+ pos 1)) token))

(define (expression parser)
  (let ((value (term parser)))
    (define (loop parser)
      (let ((op (parser-peek parser)))
        (if (member op '(#\+ #\-))
            (let* ((parser (parser-next parser))
                   (right (term parser)))
              (if (char=? op #\+)
                  (loop (make-parser (parser-tokens parser) (+ (parser-pos parser) 1)) (+ value right))
                  (loop (make-parser (parser-tokens parser) (+ (parser-pos parser) 1)) (- value right)))))
            parser)))
    (loop parser value)))

(define (term parser)
  (let ((value (factor parser)))
    (define (loop parser)
      (if (char=? (parser-peek parser) #\*)
          (let* ((parser (parser-next parser))
                 (right (factor parser)))
            (loop (make-parser (parser-tokens parser) (+ (parser-pos parser) 1)) (* value right)))
          parser))
    (loop parser value)))

(define (factor parser)
  (let* ((token (parser-next parser))
         (value (if (char=? (car token) #\()
                    (expression (make-parser (cdr token) 0))
                    (string->number token))))
    value))

(define (main)
  (let* ((text (read-line))
         (parser (make-parser (tokenize text) 0))
         (result (expression parser)))
    (display result)
    (newline)))

(main)
